# Yellow mushroom

Type: Food | Internal ID: MushroomYellow | Source: Burial Chambers, ,, Troll Cave, ,, Sunken Crypts | Usage: Crafting, Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Max Health: 10 | Max Stamina: 30 | Duration: 10m | Healing: 1 hp/tick

# Introduction

Yellow mushrooms are commonly found in Burial Chambers or Troll Caves in the Black Forest, and Sunken Crypts in the Swamp.
They can be eaten raw, or used in a Mead ketill for crafting.
As with most plants, these regrow naturally after being picked up. Picked mushrooms will respawn after 240 minutes, 4h. They are the only part of an underground chamber that regenerates.
Boars will not eat yellow mushrooms.

### Crafting

• Mead base: Medium stamina
• Mead base: Minor stamina
• Mead base: Berserkir
